description:
FILED s533 (review session, eval-in-cl plan measurement).  A PPI tokenizer bug for the PCL PPI program (#3697; catalogue + registry + ppi-bug-report.t row when it is taken).

REPRODUCER:

    our %K = (
      __FILE__ => 1,
      __DATA__ => 2,
      __END__  => 3,
    );
    print join(",", sort keys %K), "\n";

perl 5.40.3: __DATA__,__END__,__FILE__ .  PPI 1.292 (vendor/PPI, branch pcl a376a6d8): ONE PPI::Statement::Data at line 3 (`__DATA__ => 2,\n  __END__ => 3,\n);\nprint ...`) -- the rest of the file is data.  On ONE line (`my %h = (__DATA__ => 2, x => 1);`) PPI is right.

perl: a following `=>` makes `__DATA__` / `__END__` a bareword string anywhere (toke.c checks the fat comma before the keyword).  PPI: the line-start `__DATA__` / `__END__` test in the tokenizer does not look ahead for `=>`.

Impact: PCL transpiling Pl/PPIExpect.pm (self-hosting, docs/eval-in-cl-plan.md P1/P2) drops the statement; any CPAN file with this layout loses its tail.

=== DONE (s536j) ===
FIXED on PCL's PPI branch: group AX, commit e395a534 (tests 36eccb52) on branch pcl -- PPI::Token::Word::__TOKENIZER__commit looks at the rest of the word's LINE for `=>` before it starts the End / Data zone (toke.c yyl_keylookup tests the fat comma before the keyword lookup); CORE::__DATA__ / CORE::__END__ unchanged.  NB: perl reads only the same line -- `__DATA__` alone on a line with `=>` on the next IS the data section (perl: syntax error), probed.  Catalogue §64, registry row 64, report rows 401-407.  On PCL's branch the one-line spelling `(__DATA__ => 2, ...)` was a Separator too (the filing's "PPI is right on one line" no longer held).
PCL needed no change (the fat comma quotes the word).  Probe scratch/s536j/p/d1.pl perl -> main (refused: "Bug. Fell through ... Statement::Data") -> tree = perl.  Guard Pl/t/ppi-token-rows-01.t r31 (FAIL on 3139fcb0).  Pl/PPIExpect.pm's `our %KEYWORD` (the self-hosting instance) now lexes as a hash.


=== COMPLETED (s538, the reviewing session) === merged with s536j = MAIN-READY-86 d2e4ba52 (PPI pcl c2f21706), 2026-11-11.
subject: PPI (even PCL's branch, 1.292): `__DATA__ =>` at the START of a line inside a list is lexed as a DATA SECTION and swallows the rest of the file -- perl reads an autoquoted hash key; Pl/PPIExpect.pm:106 (our %KEYWORD) is the instance
